title: WashU- and Vanderbilt-commissioned report on the humanities comes under fire
summary_en: Significant pushback has come from humanities professors, the WashU chapter of the American Association of University Professors (AAUP), and the Director of the WashU Center for the Humanities, among others.
author: Lexi Lawsky
title_cn: WashU- and Vanderbilt-commissioned report on the humanities comes under fire
